title: QuoteAI — משתמשים ושימוש במערכת
description: Who is using QuoteAI right now, how much each person runs, the connection history, and the load all of it puts on the system. Presence and history come from user_activity_events (append-only, written by the backend); AI runs come from chat_logs.user_id.

list.name: online_window
list.label: חלון נוכחות
list.description: How recently a user must have hit the API to count as online.

list.name: session_gap
list.label: פער בין סשנים
list.description: Quiet period that ends a session in the sessions table.

panels.title: מחוברים כרגע
panels.description: Distinct users with any API activity inside the presence window (the window is the dashboard variable at the top). There is no logout endpoint, so presence is derived from activity, not from an open session.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT count(DISTINCT user_id) AS "online"
FROM user_activity_events
WHERE user_id IS NOT NULL
  AND event_type <> 'login_failed'
  AND created_at > now() - ('$online_window')::interval

panels.title: פעילים היום
panels.description: Distinct users active since midnight (server time).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT count(DISTINCT user_id) AS "today"
FROM user_activity_events
WHERE user_id IS NOT NULL AND event_type <> 'login_failed'
  AND created_at >= date_trunc('day', now())

panels.title: פעילים בטווח
panels.description: Distinct users active inside the dashboard's time range.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT count(DISTINCT user_id) AS "in range"
FROM user_activity_events
WHERE user_id IS NOT NULL AND event_type <> 'login_failed'
  AND $__timeFilter(created_at)

panels.title: סה״כ משתמשים
panels.description: Accounts that can log in (users.is_active).

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS "users" FROM users WHERE is_active

panels.title: התחברויות
panels.description: Successful logins. Rows marked method='SEED' are the one-time backfill from users.last_login and are excluded.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT count(*) AS "logins"
FROM user_activity_events
WHERE event_type = 'login' AND method IS DISTINCT FROM 'SEED' AND $__timeFilter(created_at)

panels.title: כשלי כניסה
panels.description: Wrong password or unknown username. A sustained rise here is either a locked-out user or someone guessing.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT count(*) AS "failed"
FROM user_activity_events
WHERE event_type = 'login_failed' AND $__timeFilter(created_at)

panels.title: מי מחובר כרגע
panels.description: One row per user seen inside the presence window. A heartbeat is written at most once per user per minute, so 'heartbeats' is roughly minutes-active, not request count.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  COALESCE(u.full_name, e.username, e.user_id)                  AS "user",
  e.username                                                     AS "username",
  COALESCE(u.role::text, e.role)                                 AS "role",
  max(e.created_at)                                              AS "last seen",
  round(extract(epoch FROM (now() - max(e.created_at))))::int    AS "seconds ago",
  (array_agg(e.ip ORDER BY e.created_at DESC))[1]                AS "ip",
  count(*)                                                       AS "heartbeats"
FROM user_activity_events e
LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id::text = e.user_id
WHERE e.user_id IS NOT NULL
  AND e.event_type <> 'login_failed'
  AND e.created_at > now() - ('$online_window')::interval
GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
ORDER BY max(e.created_at) DESC

panels.title: משתמשים פעילים לאורך זמן
panels.description: Distinct users per time bucket. Buckets follow the dashboard's interval, so a wide range means coarser buckets and a higher count per bucket.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(created_at, $__interval),
       count(DISTINCT user_id) AS "active users"
FROM user_activity_events
WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND user_id IS NOT NULL
  AND event_type <> 'login_failed'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: ריצות לפי משתמש
panels.description: Every LLM call in chat_logs, credited to the user whose request triggered it. Background work (queued jobs, the generation watchdog, n8n callbacks) has no human behind it and lands in the unattributed bucket.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COALESCE(u.full_name, 'ללא משתמש (רקע)') AS "user", count(*) AS "runs"
FROM chat_logs c
LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id::text = c.user_id
WHERE $__timeFilter(c.created_at)
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: פירוט ריצות לפי משתמש
panels.description: Runs, failures, token spend and latency per user for the selected range.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  COALESCE(u.full_name, 'ללא משתמש (רקע)')                                    AS "user",
  count(*)                                                              AS "runs",
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE c.status = 'error')                            AS "errors",
  round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE c.status = 'error') / NULLIF(count(*), 0), 1) AS "error %",
  COALESCE(sum(c.tokens_used), 0)                                       AS "tokens",
  round(avg(c.execution_time_ms) / 1000.0, 1)                           AS "avg sec",
  round(max(c.execution_time_ms) / 1000.0, 1)                           AS "max sec",
  count(DISTINCT c.proposal_id)                                         AS "deals",
  max(c.created_at)                                                     AS "last run"
FROM chat_logs c
LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id::text = c.user_id
WHERE $__timeFilter(c.created_at)
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: ריצות לאורך זמן לפי משתמש
panels.description: Stacked so the total height is the system's whole AI load and each band is one user's share.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(c.created_at, $__interval),
       COALESCE(u.full_name, 'ללא משתמש (רקע)') AS metric,
       count(*) AS value
FROM chat_logs c
LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id::text = c.user_id
WHERE $__timeFilter(c.created_at)
GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: ריצות לפי סוג פעולה
panels.description: chat_logs.source — which part of the product asked the model (generation, chat, requirements seed, work process, product breakdown…).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT c.source AS "source", count(*) AS "runs"
FROM chat_logs c
WHERE $__timeFilter(c.created_at)
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

SELECT c.status AS "status", count(*) AS "runs"
FROM chat_logs c
WHERE $__timeFilter(c.created_at)
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: התחברויות לאורך זמן
panels.description: Successful logins per bucket, per user.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(e.created_at, $__interval),
       COALESCE(u.full_name, e.username, 'unknown') AS metric,
       count(*) AS value
FROM user_activity_events e
LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id::text = e.user_id
WHERE e.event_type = 'login' AND e.method IS DISTINCT FROM 'SEED' AND $__timeFilter(e.created_at)
GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: יומן התחברויות
panels.description: Every login and failed login in range, newest first. Rows with method 'SEED' come from the one-time backfill and carry no IP or client.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  e.created_at                                    AS "time",
  COALESCE(u.full_name, e.username, 'unknown')    AS "user",
  e.username                                      AS "username",
  e.event_type                                    AS "event",
  COALESCE(u.role::text, e.role)                  AS "role",
  e.ip                                            AS "ip",
  left(e.user_agent, 60)                          AS "client"
FROM user_activity_events e
LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id::text = e.user_id
WHERE e.event_type IN ('login', 'login_failed') AND $__timeFilter(e.created_at)
ORDER BY e.created_at DESC
LIMIT 300

panels.title: סשנים (נגזרים מפעילות)
panels.description: Sessions are derived, not stored: a user's events are cut into sessions wherever they went quiet for longer than the session-gap variable. A session of 0 minutes is a single request. Because heartbeats are throttled to one a minute, session length is accurate to about a minute.

targets.rawSql:
WITH ev AS (
  SELECT user_id, username, created_at,
         CASE WHEN lag(created_at) OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY created_at) IS NULL
                OR created_at - lag(created_at) OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY created_at)
                    > ('$session_gap')::interval
              THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_new
  FROM user_activity_events
  WHERE user_id IS NOT NULL AND event_type <> 'login_failed'
    AND $__timeFilter(created_at)
), grp AS (
  SELECT *, sum(is_new) OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY created_at) AS session_no FROM ev
)
SELECT
  COALESCE(u.full_name, g.username, g.user_id)                                   AS "user",
  min(g.created_at)                                                              AS "session start",
  max(g.created_at)                                                              AS "last activity",
  round(extract(epoch FROM (max(g.created_at) - min(g.created_at))) / 60.0, 1)   AS "minutes",
  count(*)                                                                       AS "events"
FROM grp g
LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id::text = g.user_id
GROUP BY g.user_id, g.session_no, 1
ORDER BY 2 DESC
LIMIT 200

panels.title: זמן תגובה של השרת (ms)
panels.description: Measured on the sampled heartbeat requests (one per user per minute), not on every request — read it as a latency sample, not as a full percentile.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(created_at, $__interval),
       round(avg(duration_ms))                                                    AS "avg",
       round(percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY duration_ms)::numeric)  AS "p95",
       max(duration_ms)                                                           AS "max"
FROM user_activity_events
WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND duration_ms IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: המסלולים האיטיים ביותר
panels.description: Slowest endpoints by sampled p95. Deal ids appear in the path, so the same endpoint shows once per deal.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  path                                                                     AS "path",
  count(*)                                                                 AS "samples",
  round(avg(duration_ms))                                                  AS "avg ms",
  round(percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY duration_ms)::numeric) AS "p95 ms",
  max(duration_ms)                                                         AS "max ms"
FROM user_activity_events
WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND duration_ms IS NOT NULL AND path IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY 1
HAVING count(*) >= 2
ORDER BY 4 DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 30

panels.title: קודי סטטוס בתשובות
panels.description: From the sampled heartbeats. Any 5xx band at all is worth opening the logs for.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(created_at, $__interval),
       CASE WHEN status_code >= 500 THEN '5xx server error'
            WHEN status_code = 401 OR status_code = 403 THEN '401/403 auth'
            WHEN status_code >= 400 THEN '4xx client error'
            ELSE '2xx/3xx ok' END AS metric,
       count(*) AS value
FROM user_activity_events
WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND status_code IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: קריאות וטוקנים של המודל
panels.description: Model calls (/api/chat + /api/generate, embeddings excluded) and the tokens they burned, prompt + completion, as measured by the Ollama proxy (ollama_usage_events). It used to sum chat_logs.tokens_used, which is a completion-side estimate and understated the measured figure about 14x.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(created_at, $__interval),
       count(*)                                                             AS "calls",
       COALESCE(sum(COALESCE(prompt_tokens, 0) + COALESCE(completion_tokens, 0)), 0) AS "tokens"
FROM ollama_usage_events
WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND endpoint <> '/api/embed'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: משימות רקע לפי סטטוס
panels.description: Background file-processing / analysis jobs created per bucket, by status.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(created_at, $__interval),
       status AS metric,
       count(*) AS value
FROM jobs
WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at)
GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1
SELECT count(*) AS "running" FROM jobs WHERE status = 'processing'
SELECT count(*) AS "queued" FROM jobs WHERE status IN ('new', 'queued')

panels.title: ריצות AI פתוחות
panels.description: Rows still open in chat_logs. The watchdog fails anything stuck.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS "generating" FROM chat_logs WHERE status IN ('pending', 'generating')

panels.title: חיבורים פתוחים למסד
panels.description: Open PostgreSQL backends, per database. Both are shown because the dashboard's Database variable can point at either — a panel hardcoded to one of them reads 0 while you are looking at the other.

panels.title: עומס מעבד בקונטיינרים (%)
panels.description: Host-side view of the app containers, from cAdvisor.

panels.title: קריאות הטמעה
panels.description: Embedding calls in the selected range. Every RAG ingest chunk and every semantic search counts one.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT count(*) AS "embed calls"
FROM ollama_usage_events
WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND endpoint = '/api/embed'

panels.title: טוקנים בהטמעות
panels.description: Real prompt_eval_count reported by Ollama — not a chars/4 estimate.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COALESCE(sum(prompt_tokens), 0) AS "tokens"
FROM ollama_usage_events
WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND endpoint = '/api/embed'

panels.title: זמן ממוצע להטמעה
panels.description: Average Ollama-reported duration per embedding call.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT round(avg(total_duration_ms)) AS "avg ms"
FROM ollama_usage_events
WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND endpoint = '/api/embed'

panels.title: שורות ללא מונה טוקנים
panels.description: Regression guard (#366): a call recorded without a token count. Must stay 0 — anything above it means a new caller joined the blind spot.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT count(*) AS "missing"
FROM ollama_usage_events
WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND prompt_tokens IS NULL

panels.title: הטמעות וטוקנים לאורך זמן
panels.description: Embedding volume over time. Ingest arrives in bursts — one call per chunk of a document.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(created_at, $__interval),
       count(*)                          AS "embed calls",
       COALESCE(sum(prompt_tokens), 0)   AS "tokens"
FROM ollama_usage_events
WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND endpoint = '/api/embed'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: לפי endpoint ומודל
panels.description: Every Ollama endpoint the system records, with real counters. /api/chat carries completion tokens; embeddings only ever have prompt tokens.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT endpoint                                       AS "endpoint",
       COALESCE(model, '—')                           AS "model",
       count(*)                                        AS "calls",
       COALESCE(sum(prompt_tokens), 0)                 AS "prompt",
       COALESCE(sum(completion_tokens), 0)             AS "completion",
       round(avg(total_duration_ms))                   AS "avg ms",
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE prompt_tokens IS NULL)   AS "missing"
FROM ollama_usage_events
WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at)
GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 3 DESC

panels.title: מקור הקריאות
panels.description: Who made the call. Rows with no proxy timing were recorded by the backend itself (ollamaService); the rest passed through quoteai-ollama-proxy, where the IP identifies the container — the n8n worker is where RAG ingest embeds.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT CASE WHEN proxy_duration_ms IS NULL
            THEN 'backend — נרשם ישירות'
            ELSE 'proxy — ' || COALESCE(client_ip, '?')
       END                                    AS "מקור",
       count(*)                               AS "calls",
       COALESCE(sum(prompt_tokens), 0)        AS "prompt",
       round(avg(total_duration_ms))          AS "avg ms",
       max(created_at)                        AS "last seen"
FROM ollama_usage_events
WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at)
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: כיסוי טוקנים לפי מקור (ריצות ללא מונה)
panels.description: Completed chat_logs runs per source and how many carry no token count (tokens_used NULL or 0). A source that appears with a red 'ללא מונה' is a blind spot in the token figures. scripts/verify.sh fails when a source with 5+ runs in 7 days drops below 80% coverage.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT source                                                        AS "מקור",
       count(*)                                                      AS "ריצות",
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE COALESCE(tokens_used, 0) = 0)          AS "ללא מונה",
       round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE COALESCE(tokens_used, 0) > 0) / count(*), 1) AS "כיסוי %"
FROM chat_logs
WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND status = 'completed'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 3 DESC, 2 DESC

panels.title: כיסוי שיוך
panels.description: Share of recorded calls that carry a deal. Deliberately uncoloured: n8n's langchain LLM nodes cannot attribute at all, so this never reaches 100% and a low value is not a fault.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE proposal_id IS NOT NULL)
             / nullif(count(*), 0)) AS "pct"
FROM ollama_usage_events
WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at)

panels.title: עסקאות שנמדדו
panels.description: Distinct deals with at least one attributed call in range.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT count(DISTINCT proposal_id) AS "deals"
FROM ollama_usage_events
WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND proposal_id IS NOT NULL

panels.title: טוקנים משויכים
panels.description: Prompt tokens that can be charged to a specific deal.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COALESCE(sum(prompt_tokens), 0) AS "tokens"
FROM ollama_usage_events
WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND proposal_id IS NOT NULL

panels.title: לפי עסקה
panels.description: What each deal cost. Joined on proposals."dealName" (quoted camelCase — the column is not deal_name). Unattributed calls are kept as their own row rather than hidden, so the totals still add up. Cost is an ESTIMATE: tokens x model_rates (placeholder prices for a comparable paid API — the models run locally). 'ללא תעריף' counts calls whose model has no rate row.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COALESCE(p."dealName", e.proposal_id, '(לא משויך)') AS "עסקה",
       count(*)                          AS "calls",
       COALESCE(sum(e.prompt_tokens), 0) AS "prompt",
       COALESCE(sum(e.completion_tokens), 0) AS "completion",
       COALESCE(round(sum(
         COALESCE(e.prompt_tokens, 0)     / 1000.0 * COALESCE(r.prompt_per_1k, 0)
       + COALESCE(e.completion_tokens, 0) / 1000.0 * COALESCE(r.completion_per_1k, 0)
       ), 4), 0)                          AS "עלות מוערכת ₪",
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE r.model IS NULL) AS "ללא תעריף",
       round(avg(e.total_duration_ms))   AS "avg ms",
       max(e.created_at)                 AS "last seen"
FROM ollama_usage_events e
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT m.model, m.prompt_per_1k, m.completion_per_1k FROM model_rates m
  WHERE m.model = regexp_replace(e.model, ':latest$', '') AND m.effective_from <= e.created_at
  ORDER BY m.effective_from DESC LIMIT 1) r ON true
LEFT JOIN proposals p ON p.id = e.proposal_id
WHERE $__timeFilter(e.created_at)
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 5 DESC

panels.title: לפי משתמש
panels.description: Who caused the spend. Background work — queued jobs, the watchdog, n8n — has no user and is reported as such, not hidden. The join casts the uuid to text (not the reverse), so a malformed user_id degrades to showing itself instead of breaking the panel. Cost is an ESTIMATE: tokens x model_rates (placeholder prices for a comparable paid API — the models run locally). 'ללא תעריף' counts calls whose model has no rate row.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COALESCE(u.username, e.user_id, '(רקע / ללא משתמש)') AS "משתמש",
       count(*)                          AS "calls",
       COALESCE(sum(e.prompt_tokens), 0) AS "prompt",
       COALESCE(sum(e.completion_tokens), 0) AS "completion",
       COALESCE(round(sum(
         COALESCE(e.prompt_tokens, 0)     / 1000.0 * COALESCE(r.prompt_per_1k, 0)
       + COALESCE(e.completion_tokens, 0) / 1000.0 * COALESCE(r.completion_per_1k, 0)
       ), 4), 0)                          AS "עלות מוערכת ₪",
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE r.model IS NULL) AS "ללא תעריף",
       round(avg(e.total_duration_ms))   AS "avg ms",
       max(e.created_at)                 AS "last seen"
FROM ollama_usage_events e
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT m.model, m.prompt_per_1k, m.completion_per_1k FROM model_rates m
  WHERE m.model = regexp_replace(e.model, ':latest$', '') AND m.effective_from <= e.created_at
  ORDER BY m.effective_from DESC LIMIT 1) r ON true
LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id::text = e.user_id
WHERE $__timeFilter(e.created_at)
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 5 DESC

panels.title: לפי סוג עבודה
panels.description: Which kind of work burns embeddings: rag-ingest, rag-search, semantic-search, hybrid-search, image-index, image-search. Cost is an ESTIMATE: tokens x model_rates (placeholder prices for a comparable paid API — the models run locally). 'ללא תעריף' counts calls whose model has no rate row.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COALESCE(e.source, '(לא משויך)')  AS "סוג עבודה",
       count(*)                          AS "calls",
       COALESCE(sum(e.prompt_tokens), 0) AS "prompt",
       COALESCE(sum(e.completion_tokens), 0) AS "completion",
       COALESCE(round(sum(
         COALESCE(e.prompt_tokens, 0)     / 1000.0 * COALESCE(r.prompt_per_1k, 0)
       + COALESCE(e.completion_tokens, 0) / 1000.0 * COALESCE(r.completion_per_1k, 0)
       ), 4), 0)                          AS "עלות מוערכת ₪",
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE r.model IS NULL) AS "ללא תעריף",
       round(avg(e.total_duration_ms))   AS "avg ms"
FROM ollama_usage_events e
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT m.model, m.prompt_per_1k, m.completion_per_1k FROM model_rates m
  WHERE m.model = regexp_replace(e.model, ':latest$', '') AND m.effective_from <= e.created_at
  ORDER BY m.effective_from DESC LIMIT 1) r ON true
WHERE $__timeFilter(e.created_at)
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 5 DESC

panels.title: פעולות מתועדות
panels.description: Audited actions in range. Phase 1 covers AI runs (agent.run) and product-breakdown confirmations; phases 2-5 extend this to the workflow gates, content, delivery and admin actions.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT count(*) AS "actions"
FROM audit_events
WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at)

panels.title: שחקנים מזוהים
panels.description: Distinct actors — humans and named background actors together.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT count(DISTINCT COALESCE(user_id, actor_type)) AS "actors"
FROM audit_events
WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at)

panels.title: שורות שחקן פגום
panels.description: Rows claiming actor_type='user' but carrying no user_id. actor_type is NOT NULL so a truly blank actor cannot exist; this catches the real failure — getActor() resolving a request with no authenticated id. Must stay 0.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT count(*) AS "broken"
FROM audit_events
WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND actor_type = 'user' AND user_id IS NULL

panels.title: מי עשה מה
panels.description: Every actor and what they did. Background work is shown as its actor_type in parentheses rather than hidden — the unattributed bucket is reported, not dropped, exactly as the runs-per-user panel does.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COALESCE(u.username, e.username, e.user_id, '(' || e.actor_type || ')') AS "מבצע",
       e.action                          AS "פעולה",
       count(*)                          AS "פעמים",
       max(e.created_at)                 AS "אחרון"
FROM audit_events e
LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id::text = e.user_id
WHERE $__timeFilter(e.created_at)
GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 3 DESC

panels.title: מי נגע בעסקה
panels.description: Who touched which deal. Joined on proposals."dealName" (quoted camelCase — there is no deal_name column).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COALESCE(p."dealName", e.proposal_id, '(ללא עסקה)') AS "עסקה",
       COALESCE(e.username, '(' || e.actor_type || ')')      AS "מבצע",
       e.action                          AS "פעולה",
       count(*)                          AS "פעמים",
       max(e.created_at)                 AS "אחרון"
FROM audit_events e
LEFT JOIN proposals p ON p.id = e.proposal_id
WHERE $__timeFilter(e.created_at)

panels.title: פיד פעילות
panels.description: The raw trail, newest first. chat_log links an action to the AI run it fired, and through that run to its measured token cost (#366).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT e.created_at                     AS "מתי",
       COALESCE(e.username, '(' || e.actor_type || ')') AS "מבצע",
       e.action                          AS "פעולה",
       COALESCE(e.entity_type, '—')      AS "ישות",
       COALESCE(e.proposal_id, '—')      AS "עסקה",
       COALESCE(left(e.chat_log_id, 8), '—') AS "chat log",
       COALESCE(e.ip, '—')               AS "ip"
FROM audit_events e
WHERE $__timeFilter(e.created_at)
ORDER BY e.created_at DESC LIMIT 100
